answer: Divergent Path Registration: each identity must periodically submit a signed traversal path through a shared random graph, seeded per epoch. A clone farm holding identical keys produces identical paths, collapsing to one vertex in the graph. Honest agents diverge, and the spread across that tide of distinct paths is what admits them. A canyon between submissions exposes the fork. Cost: each Sybil identity needs independent entropy and separate signing hardware, priced per clone.
